stem.text: A wave is formed on a string.
A student plots a graph of the variation of displacement $d$ with time $t$ for a point on the string.
The student marks two points, X and Y, on the graph.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement d against time t with axes labelled d (vertical) and t (horizontal) and 0 at the origin. A wave curve of two crests is drawn, with the printed points X and Y marked on the time axis.

stem.text: Which property of the wave is represented by the distance along the horizontal axis between X and Y?
